notes: Hard: the live daemon's key exists only in an ephemeral keyfile the daemon deletes at startup, so the deliverable must perform genuine chosen-plaintext recovery (2 queries separate the S-box from the position mask), then sweep the 65536-seed space inside a 60s wall budget. A naive build-then-check brute force takes minutes and busts the budget; the intended attack prunes each candidate during Fisher-Yates construction (entries S[i..255] are final once step i runs), rejecting wrong seeds after ~2 steps. The grader re-seeds the daemon per case (visible + 3 hidden), counts queries from the daemon's own log (<= 64), and times the run.
